purpose: Authoritative registry for historical Taiwan market-data acquisition. This registry contains policy/source metadata only; licensed raw market data must remain outside the public repository and outside third-party CI unless the provider explicitly permits that processing location.
legal_questions_requiring_documented_yes: May the purchased historical data be processed automatically by software for backtesting and model validation?
May the purchased data be stored on the operator's private encrypted storage for the licensed period/use?
May the data be transformed into technical indicators, model features, rankings, scores and holding/exit analysis?
May derived analytical outputs be shown to end users without redistributing raw rows?
If cloud compute is used, does the licence permit processing by the named cloud/hosting provider and jurisdiction?
What source attribution or order/subscription identification must accompany external outputs?
What retention, deletion, user-count, retransmission and termination restrictions apply?
activation_gates: market_index coverage confirmed for regime testing

ogdl_daily_forward_archive.note: Open-data observations already lawfully collected may be archived forward. They are not a substitute for missing historical backfill.
ogdl_daily_forward_archive.activation_note: The formal activation path does not require waiting for this archive to accumulate 120 trading days; licensed historical backfill remains the primary path.

documented_facts_reviewed_2026_09_16: TWMD terms grant access/use according to plan entitlement and prohibit resale/sublicensing/redistribution except where a dataset licence separately permits it.
TWMD states that part of its Taiwan data is sourced from Government Open Data Platform under OGDL-1.0 and requires licence attribution when reused.
The free plan is explicitly non-commercial; commercial StockLab use therefore requires an eligible paid entitlement or separate written permission.
TWSE and TPEx daily-price endpoints expose historical OHLCV and identify official exchange source roles.
TWMD security-master documentation explicitly says the active snapshot is not point-in-time complete and warns of survivorship bias for backtests.
TWMD trading-calendar documentation says historical rows are derived from observed price rows rather than a complete official exchange calendar.
TWMD attention/disposition documentation warns that event_date is not the announcement knowledge date, so event_date alone is unsafe for historical information-set replay.
TWMD market-index documentation currently states TWSE rows are available while TPEx returns none, so a separate lawful TPEx broad-market index history is required for regime validation.
activation_requirements: retain the exact paid-plan entitlement and current terms/version
retain explicit evidence that commercial API acquisition, automated processing, private storage, derived analysis and public derived outputs are allowed for StockLab
keep TWMD_API_KEY only in the approved private processing environment
run private staging outside the public repository and public CI
obtain PIT-safe historical security lifecycle rather than relying on the current active security-master snapshot
obtain a provenance-valid trading calendar that satisfies StockLab's no-guessing calendar contract
obtain PIT-safe corporate-action and attention/disposition knowledge dates for historical replay
obtain lawful broad-market index history for both TWSE and TPEx before bull/bear/sideways OOS labels are allowed
normalize all required datasets through import-licensed-history.py and then validate-licensed-bundle.py
cross-check overlapping recent OHLC observations against official exchange observations
never commit raw or staged provider rows to the public repository unless the exact contract explicitly permits redistribution

official_terms_facts: TWSE Data E-Shop terms prohibit automated/scripted downloading unless done in a TWSE-approved manner or with TWSE consent.
The product page distinguishes internal use from external use.
External use permits transmission of subscribed product content to information users subject to the online subscription terms.
TWSE online-order terms state that creating an index or other derivative product from purchased content requires prior written TWSE consent.
unresolved_for_stocklab: Whether StockLab model/backtest computation is covered by ordinary internal/external use or requires additional written consent.
Whether public derived rankings/scores/holding-exit outputs are permitted without distributing raw rows.
Whether automated delivery/downloading is permitted for the selected subscription method.
Whether third-party cloud processing is permitted.
activation_requirements: retain the exact order terms and product specification
obtain written clarification from TWSE for any unresolved automated-processing/derived-output/cloud-processing question
download only through an explicitly permitted delivery mechanism
ingest only on approved private storage/compute
verify file SHA-256, schema, dates, OHLC ordering and row counts
cross-check overlapping recent dates against official TWSE observations
never publish or commit raw rows beyond granted rights
